title: explore_entry_filter
description: Score a learned migrate entry filter (tools/exploration_entry_model_b3.py) over one of the three frozen settings, one exit (tools/exploration_exits.py), on exploration-pool data only. See docs/contracts/job-templates.md.

trigger.description: Entry trigger event. Only the pump.fun bonding-curve migration trigger is supported.

model.description: Learned entry-filter setting (tools/exploration_entry_model_b3.py SETTINGS_B3): s1_reg is LightGBM regression on per-trade pressure-model net %; s2_clf is a LightGBM classifier on P(pressure net > 0), the EXP-011 pre-registered setting; s3_reg_winsor is regression with labels winsorized at the training fold's own 1st/99th percentile.

select_top_pct.description: Take the top N percent of each held-out day's migrations by model score (k = max(1, round(n*N/100))). Mutually exclusive with threshold -- set exactly one.

threshold.description: Take migrations whose model score is >= this absolute cut (0..1) -- the EXP-011 enter rule. Only valid with model s2_clf (a probability); the regression settings score in net-percent and are refused. Mutually exclusive with select_top_pct -- set exactly one.

exit.description: Exit rule id, one of the 41 cells tools/exploration_exits.py's build_specs() produces (tp/sl grid, trailing stop, time cap on tp50/sl30, partial-take ladder).

size_sol.description: Position size in SOL per entry. The frozen migrate-direct execution this template scores today is 0.5 SOL.

priority_fee_tier.description: Priority-fee tier for slot+1 landing. The frozen execution uses the p75 tier (0.0005 SOL/side = 500,000 lamports, ARTIFACTS/lab/fee-audit-2026-09-27.md); p50 (0.000058 SOL/side = 58,000 lamports, same audit) is wired; p90 has no audited value and is refused by the runner.

mcap_band.description: Optional market-cap band filter in USD. Not supported by the scorer (no band filter): anything but null/omitted is refused by the runner.

min.description: Minimum market cap in USD, inclusive.

max.description: Maximum market cap in USD, exclusive.

fast_pool_root.description: Root of pool A (fast-box sealed hours: trades/ and creates/). Must resolve (symlinks and .. followed) to an allowlisted exploration root or the run is refused before any file is opened. Null uses env MAL_FAST_POOL_ROOT, else /var/lib/mal/backfill-fast. On mal-research-0: /data/mal/clean-view/fast-pool-2026-09-18T23_2026-09-22T00.

insample_pool_root.description: Root of pool C (Oracle in-sample backfill, 2026-09-22T00..2026-09-25T06). Same allowlist rule. Null uses env MAL_INSAMPLE_POOL_ROOT, else /home/claude/data/oracle-insample-2026-09-22_25. On mal-research-0: /data/mal/clean-view/oracle-insample-2026-09-22_25.

live_pool_root.description: Root of pool B (Oracle live tape, 2026-09-25T07..2026-09-27T23, plus observe-<day>.jsonl creates). Same allowlist rule. Null uses env MAL_LIVE_POOL_ROOT, else /home/claude/data/oracle-live-2026-09-25_27. On mal-research-0: /data/mal/clean-view/oracle-live-2026-09-25_27.

days.description: Exploration-pool UTC days to score, leave-one-day-out over exactly these days (docs/HOLDOUT_LEDGER.md), or "all" for the full 9-day exploration pool tools/exploration_entry_model_b3.py already uses (2026-09-19 through 2026-09-27).
